newsitem.title: UK: BADMINTON-ENGLAND WOMAN PLAYER DUMPS DRINK ON MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-ENGLAND WOMAN PLAYER DUMPS DRINK ON MANAGER.

text.p: England's badminton manager got a surprise when one of the country's top women players tipped a can of coke over his head and stormed out of his office.

Jo Muggeridge, who has struggled with weight problems during her career, was told by director of elite play Steve Baddeley she would not receive national funding unless she joined the squad's training and fitness regime and played in domestic tournaments.
An enraged Muggeridge then reportedly vowed she would never again play badminton for England as she doused Baddeley with her drink.

The sport has known Muggeridge fury before -- Jo's father Vic was accused of head-butting and threatening her coach after she suffered a surprise doubles defeat at the national championships two years ago.
"I don't know what's going to happen to her. You just don't go around pouring drinks on the manager," Maryanne Henchy spokeswoman for the Badminton Association of England said on Sunday.
